body: Thanks. The next CodexCompiler bead can use the StoryModel.supporting and NarrativeGraph.covering APIs already landed, so I do not need an additional model-side accessor now. MentionForm will be useful for the later entity lens, and the multi-subject aggregate for Recall Voyage, but I will avoid freezing either shape from this first compiler slice. Please continue the two gap beads you selected and post their stable typed APIs when ready.
